in_timeline.title: Creative Hackathon Kickoff & Team Formation
in_timeline.description: Start with themed icebreaker activities and immersive team-building challenges that spark creativity and collaboration among participants.

in_timeline.title: Interactive Mentorship & Workshops
in_timeline.description: Host hands-on tech demos and live problem-solving sessions led by industry innovators to engage participants deeply in banking technologies and cybersecurity.

in_timeline.title: Experiential Networking & Sponsor Booths
in_timeline.description: Create experiential zones with gamified sponsor interactions and virtual reality demos to enhance networking and engagement with fintech partners.

in_timeline.title: Dynamic Pitching & Awards Ceremony
in_timeline.description: Incorporate dynamic presentation formats, audience voting, and surprise creativity awards to celebrate innovation and team achievements.

in_timeline.title: Enhanced Participant Engagement with AR & Social Contests
in_timeline.description: Expand gamification through augmented reality quests, social media storytelling contests, and personalized recognition moments to maintain excitement.
